entities.summary: Dr. Vimaltai Nandkishor Mundada was an Indian politician from Maharashtra belonging to the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP). During 2004–09, she was minister of Minister of Public Works and Minister for Health in the Government of Maharashtra.
